faqs.a:
Unless otherwise provided by law, information submitted as part of an application
               is open to public inspection and subject to the Colorado Open Records Act. It is the
               applicant's responsibility to be familiar with the Colorado Open Records Act. An applicant
               may specifically identify any information it considers proprietary. In the event that
               Arvada receives a request from another party to disclose any information which the
               applicant has deemed proprietary, Arvada will tender to the applicant the defense
               of any request to compel disclosure. By submitting information which the applicant
               deems proprietary or otherwise exempt from disclosure, the applicant agrees to defend
               and hold harmless Arvada from any claim for disclosure including but not limited to
               any expenses including out-of-pocket costs and attorneys' fees, as well as any judgment
               entered against Arvada for the attorney fees of the party requesting disclosure.
(
Ord. No. 4078, § 1, 7-16-07
)
